sources_applied.name: partner account03/B13 countable no-pivot extreme equivalence

summary: If full QFORM fails, then for every m>=2 there is a rational finite-grid strict no-m^-4-pivot witness with slab ratio >9sqrt(3e)m, entrywise coefficients O(m^-2), dimension >sqrt(3/2)m^2, s5(A[I,J])<1/m for every disjoint physical cut, and every cut with s3>=1/m has >2/3 row and column volume marginals, hence >1/3 doubly anchored third-minor mass. Separately, exact disjoint cross rank <=r on every cut implies A=diagonal+R with rank(R)<=4r.
first_unpaid_implication: QFORM-NOPIVOT-CROSSRANK4-STABILITY-v1: obtain a dimension-free quantitative/product-compatible stability theorem from uniformly small fifth cross singular values plus double-anchored third-volume structure, or construct a diverging finite-grid witness sequence satisfying this normal form.
next_step: Attempt quantitative Nyström/deshear reconstruction using a maximal physical cross pivot while retaining the grid-product law before any reciprocal minor payment; split surviving rank-three cuts by the >1/3 double-anchor certificate and use hub/mixed-Fresnel bounds when the anchor bank is quantitative.
